notes.title: Reiko's Fragments now available for PC (No VR headset required.)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

I know it's been a while since we last updated, been quite the year to say the least, but the team has been developing some new features that you have been requesting. One particular requested feature that we've heard again and again, was Reiko's Fragments to be playable on PC with Keyboard and Mouse, no VR headset needed.

Well, do we have good news for you. [b]Reiko's Fragments is now available for PC[/b]. We are thrilled to release this update and expand the Reiko community. 

To quickly clarify any confusion, Reiko's is still a VR title, but for those who don't own a VR headset, can now play Reiko's as well. Also, any future updates will be available for both versions. 

We hope everyone has a safe and exciting Halloween!

Speaking of which, the Pixel team is excited to see people playing live over Halloween, you may never know, a Dev or two might just hop in your game and give a scare. ^ - ^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971501/a5fb192f1f3572af0219df664854bb65d5ffe47f.png[/img]

Stay Spooky -

notes.title: Reiko's Fragments Wins - Most Immersive XR Experience at Dreamland XR / CES2020
notes.content:
[url=https://www.pixelcanvasstudios.com/blog/2020/1/15/reikos-fragments-wins-most-immersive-xr-experience-at-ces]Read the full story here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971501/408f6d892569e1390f72629c7b673b2cc58e7c64.jpg[/img]

HEY, AGAIN REIKO FANS!  

Where do I begin? 2019 was easily the most exciting and challenging year for the Pixel Canvas Team. The team put in a remarkable amount of time and energy throughout the year being part of several incredible venues showcasing Reiko's. From 626 Night Market to Comic-Con, just to name a few. Reiko's Fragments also made its debut on Steam in time for the Halloween through the Early Access program. 

The Pixel team didn't stop there, hustling through the holidays to release a new map and several performance improvements. We continue to remain committed to our Early Access promise and have several great new features we cant wait to share soon!   But, why stop there? Every year we look for new ways to raise the bar and what better way to kick off the year than attending CES at the DreamlandXR Experience!  DreamlandXR was stunning, to say the least. Sharing the floor with some incredibly talented studios, like ARWall, Chicken Waffle, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971501/cbbd3cfa79b90cc2b87786e92ad029754c073c08.png[/img]

Honestly, it was a pleasure to meet so many talented people and have the Pixel Team on-site to represent our product and values. Joey and Liam both received the opportunity to speak during the panels for the DreamlandXR event.   The Highlight, as you guessed, when we received the award for the most Immersive XR experience. It is a great honor to receive such an award and only encourages us to work harder. 

2019 was an incredible year and I can't think of any better way to kick off 2020 than winning an award at CES.  

As always, stay tuned for new announcements.

notes.title: New Map Released - The Shrine
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gIoMfmrOZaY;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Somewhere deep in the northern forests, lies a hidden shrine dedicated to the King of Hell.[/i]

[h3]Pixel Canvas Studios is excited to reveal Reiko's Fragments first major update - Shrine. [/h3]
Throughout the course of production, we had a lot of ideas we wanted to visit. The haunted house was a no brainer and wanted to established that map first before moving on to other ideas. Shrine was everything we were wanting to explore. An outside environment, weather elements, new design, and audio.  Everything fits so perfectly. When I say perfectly, I mean terrifying. 

Shrine is easily the most intense experience yet, that truly haunting experience when the Fog rolls across the map, unable to see around you, hearing the ghost walk towards you. That will get your heart panicking every time. 

This is a [b]Free [/b]update and will be available on December 19th. 

To learn more, [url=https://www.pixelcanvasstudios.com/blog/2019/12/13/new-map-the-shrine]please visit here[/url] to see the full details of the Shrine map.

notes.title: Deploying Server Hotfix
notes.content:
Due to the number of players using our servers today, we had major connection issues with players unable to join and start games. To address the issues today, we are deploying a hotfix that increases the number of server instances. 

This will disconnect current active sessions so you will need to restart the current game sessions. We hope this will resolve the issues we encountered today and prevent incidents like this from happening in the future. For Mobile / Web Browser players we suggest clearing your cookies to bring you back to ReikoVR.com login screen. 

Thank you for your patience as we're working around the clock to make sure you all have the best experience possible!

notes.title: Server Congestion Issues
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Reiko's Fragments Players![/h1]

Wow! What an incredible night, we knew Reiko's Fragments would be popular for Halloween but we never expected it to be [b]THIS[/b] popular! 

Because there are so many current players at the same time, the server is having some minor issues. The developers are working around the clock to keep the network stable. We apologize for any issues this may cause. Any issues you may be dealing with are temporary. 

Again, thank you all for being so awesome and have a HAPPY HALLOWEEN!

Stay Spooky.
